'''U-One''' was a legendary [[Planet/Legends|planet]], populated solely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

It could not be found on any [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] map, and was entirely self-sufficient, with no need for contact with the larger [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Any being who came upon the planet, or attempted to contact those on the surface, was forbidden to land.

Legends differed over the geography of the planet; some said that it was a pleasant place, with plains, gentle hills, and whispering brooks, while others claimed it was an inhospitable rock, wracked with earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated that U-One was excluded from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] because it was an imaginary location.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion_2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-05-23}}</ref>
